name: Alter-Self
source:
You are a 23 years old drop-out, who moved to New York to become a doctor, but ever since that last exam  you locked yourself in your apartment for almost a year. After failing to pay the rent, you were kicked out of the apartment and if it weren't for your sister, you would be living with your parents. She works, while you take care of her place, but it all changed one day. Now, in your quest for a better life, you will face life changing events that will shape your personality.

[Edited from Patreon]
